reason: S1 makes a correctly sized work buffer mandatory for wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame, but H0 always passes an empty wuffs_base__slice_u8. For images whose decoded width is nonzero, H0 now exits with wuffs_base__error__bad_work_buffer_length before reaching wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_id_part1. S0 had no work-buffer-length check, so the same H0 call reached frame decoding; the material loss of reachability is commit-induced.
evidence: H0 calls wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame with ((wuffs_base__slice_u8){}), whose length is zero.
S1 adds a check in wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame requiring a_work_buffer.len to equal self->private_impl.f_width and returns wuffs_base__error__bad_work_buffer_length otherwise.
S1 changes wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_image_config to publish a work-buffer range whose min_incl and max_incl both equal self->private_impl.f_width.
The new length check occurs before wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame_config and wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_id_part1, blocking H0 from exercising frame decoding.
S0's displayed complete wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame body contained no corresponding work-buffer validation.
recommended_action: After wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_image_config, read wuffs_base__image_config__work_buffer_size, allocate a bounded buffer of the required length, pass that slice to every wuffs_gif__decoder__decode_frame call, and free it on exit.
